case_title: JAMES O BUSTOS VS. MATILDE NADONZA ET AL

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,825.00 FILED BY BUSTOS, JAMES O AS TO DEFENDANT NADONZA, MATILDE NADONZA, THERESA MA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-04-2016 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF AUG-04-2016 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF AUG-04-2016 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF JAMES O. BUSTOS AND DEFENDANTS MATILDA NADOZA & THERESA MA NADONZA. MARIANNA NADONZA WAS PLACED UNDER OATH AND SERVED AS TAGALOG SPEAKING INTERPRETER FOR DEFENDANT MATILDE NADONZA. PLAINTIFF PRESENTED THE CLERK WITH TWO SEPARATE PROOFS OF PERSONAL SERVICE FOR DEFENDANTS, EACH OF WHICH WAS INVALID ITS FACE. BOTH MATILDE NADONZA & THERESA MA NADONZA WAIVED SERVICE OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. NOT REPORTED. (D506).

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-04-2016 - CONTINUED ON THE COURT'S OWN MOTION TO AUG-30-2016 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF JAMES O. BUSTOS AND DEFENDANTS MATILDE NADONZA & THERESA MA NADONZA. PLAINTIFF PRESENTED THE CLERK WITH AN INVALID PROOF OF SERVICE AS TO EACH DEFENDANT, BUT BOTH MATILDE NADONZA & THERESA MA NADONZA WAIVED SERVICE OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM AT TODAY'S HEARING. EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. NOT REPORTED. (D506).
DISMISSAL OF ENTIRE ACTION OF ALL PARTIES AND ALL CAUSES OF ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE CLAIM HEARING OF AUG-30-2016 OFF CALENDAR, DISMISSAL FILED
